preconditions: No physical move of the authoritative reference mirror tree in the current phase.

Namespace registry, manifest, and migration candidate contract must stay version-aligned before any future move candidate is promoted.
Reference provenance and bundle identity must remain intact across any future archive handling.
planned_steps: Treat project_assets/reference_mirrors/upstream_audit as the sole authoritative namespace anchor for the mirror bundle.
Preserve the root upstream_audit symlink unchanged as the only required compatibility entrypoint in this phase.
Keep upstream subtrees namespaced under the existing upstream_audit root; do not flatten per-repository mirrors into new top-level paths.
If a later phase introduces deeper archive partitioning, update contracts and keep upstream_audit resolving through a compatibility layer.
forbidden_actions: No destructive cleanup of mirrored upstream repositories.
No removal or repointing of the upstream_audit compatibility symlink in the current phase.
No in-place rewriting of mirrored upstream repositories only to normalize layout.
No introduction of new root-level reference-mirror trees outside project_assets/reference_mirrors.
